The heightfield and cosine-drop equations in js/water.js are adapted from
water.js in WebGL Water. Adaptations use Three.js render targets, combined drop
and update passes, absorbing boundaries, and a 128 × 128 half-float field.
The landing's surface shader/backdrops and bag integration are separate work.
